Comment: IRIS RWE pipeline. Raw file arrives -> preflight -> validate/transform -> QC gate -> cohort -> notify. The gate is a real branch: a FAIL routes to the alert path and the cohort is never built.

Retry.Comment: Transient service errors retry. A QC gate failure raises SystemExit inside the job, surfacing as Glue.JobRunFailed, which is deliberately NOT retried - rerunning bad data produces the same bad result.

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline succeeded
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} completed. Source file: s3://{}/{}. Cohort query: {}', $$.Execution.Name, $.bucket, $.key, $.athena.QueryExecution.QueryExecutionId)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline halted: preflight
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} halted at preflight. File s3://{}/{} did not match the expected schema. This is an engineering issue - check whether the site changed its export format.', $$.Execution.Name, $.bucket, $.key)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline halted: data quality gate
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} halted at the QC gate. The curated layer was NOT written and no cohort was built. See s3://{}/metadata/{}/validation_report.json. A clinical-plausibility failure needs a scientist, not an engineer.', $$.Execution.Name, $.bucket, $$.Execution.Name)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline failed: cohort query
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} failed during cohort construction. Curated data is intact; the query itself failed.', $$.Execution.Name)

Halted.Cause: The pipeline stopped before producing a cohort. See the SNS notification and the validation report for which gate failed.
